summary: Postinstall downloads CLI binary from a third-party GitHub org without integrity verification
details: install.cjs runs at postinstall and downloads a platform-specific `apex` CLI binary from https://github.com/Apex-Foundation/copilot/releases at a pinned version (v1.0.0), then chmods it 0755. The download org (Apex-Foundation/copilot) does not match the package's declared repository (can1357/oh-my-pi) or homepage (omp.sh). Transport is HTTPS and the version is pinned, but no hash or signature is verified against the downloaded asset. The script reads os.platform/arch and a couple of environment values (HOME, USERPROFILE) only to select the correct asset name and install path; no environment scraping or exfiltration to an external endpoint is present. The behavior is the standard prebuilt-native-binary install shape (loader + versioned GitHub release), but the mismatch between the publisher's declared repo and the download org, together with the absence of checksum verification, leaves the delivered bytes unverifiable.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
